title: CODEX task435: Linnik1951
head: codex/task435
body:
Prove the binary phase concentration, entropy measure, interval cover and rational system cover inputs from Linnik 1951 Lemmas 4 through 6. Reuse the freshly proved full circle coefficient identity and reconnect the exact original main conclusion.

The branch adds fifty theorem statements. Forty three are PROVED with committed module builds and clean axioms. Six assemblies are CONDITIONAL. One new OPEN leaf retains the explicit local expansion from page 166 equation 9.1. Its elementary totient and logarithm steps are proved. The main conclusion remains CONDITIONAL on five analytic inputs.

Every original Lean file is byte identical to fresh main. The sorry delta is plus one. All fifty statements MATCH their source consequences and twins. Twenty exact target type comparisons pass. The explicit entropy fraction is one over 1048576 and its phase sets have positive measure.

AI wrote the Lean code. Binary Goldbach is open.

The gate prints RESULT PASS. Its warning counts five first lines with sorryAx. The complete multiline audit records seven dependent declarations, exactly six labelled CONDITIONAL assemblies and one OPEN leaf. No other foreign axiom is present.
